text:
Clara: starting a small A/B for the latency vs cost story. want to test two chart treatments + two CTAs. quick thoughts?
Priya: yup. what are the two chart treatments?
Clara: A: single image - split panel: left = cost per 1k tokens (bars), right = 95th latency (line). B: unified plot - x=tokens, y=$/1k with latency iso-curves overlay.
Mateo: B feels more nerdy but more honest. A is better for quick social.
Jonah: agree. B for blog + product page, A for social cards and newsletter header.
Priya: CTA split suggestion: Variant 1 -> "Try the cost calculator" (self-serve). Variant 2 -> "See a live demo" (sales). run 50/50 across paid social.
Clara: targeting: devs on X and HN -> push to calculator; PMs and infra leads -> demo. include a hidden form field: estimated monthly tokens.
Mateo: KPI for win: demo signups with >100M tokens OR calc uses with >3 minutes active. secondary: CTR to blog.
Jonah: can ops share representative numbers for hosted/dedicated/private? need $/1k and 95th lat for 512-token requests.
Priya: I'll ask infra for a small anonymized sample table. request: Host: "hosted-default", "dedicated-reserved", "private-optimized". no customer names.
Clara: copy testing: short headline options: 1) "Pay less or get faster — pick your path" 2) "Same model, different serving choices" 3) "Latency targets don't have to break the bank"
Mateo: Love #1 for social. #3 better for execs.
Jonah: also want a microcopy for the calc tool: "Slide latency target to see estimated $/1k". can we GIF that for social?
Priya: GIF = yes. engineering can produce 3 frames showing slider at 100ms/200ms/500ms and resulting $/1k.
Clara: inbound routing: form field "primary priority" (Cost / Latency / Compliance). map Cost->calc follow-up email; Latency->AE outreach; Compliance->enterprise-sales. add UTM tag to route source channel.
Mateo: SDR rule: if estimated tokens > 100M OR company size >200 -> bump to AE immediately.
Jonah: legal check: avoid comparative claims like "40% cheaper" unless we have a customer-approved case. use general ranges: "up to 40% in some configs" with a small footnote.
Priya: noted. we'll use range language and an asterisk linking to methodology in the blog.
mktg-bot: reminder set for 1744200000 to review A/B mockups and copy. :calendar:
Clara: timeline: mockups today, tech numbers by EOD tomorrow, ads + form wired by Thu. keep creatives under 3 visuals each.
Mateo: I'll sketch the B chart and a GIF. pinging infra now.
Clara: perfect. thanks team — will drop drafts here when ready. :rocket:
